notes: Widget Photo Picker, Smooth Widget Animations & Clean Lyrics UI (v2.0.4): Fixed Widget Customizer Photo Picker on HEIC/AVIF and single-use gallery streams (single-read temp file + ImageDecoder + automatic GetContent fallback), fixed Home Screen Lyrics widget line transition animations by keeping composite & Khmer bitmaps well below the 1 MB Binder IPC limit (RGB_565 + self-relative slide transitions), removed the floating circle overlay from the Lyrics screen for an uncluttered reading view, and cleaned up the TAP Sync button styling in the Custom Lyrics Editor

Widget Customizer & Live Settings Preview (v2.0.3): Added Settings > Widgets > Customize widget with live 2:1 preview, 9 Frame styles, 5 Backgrounds, Blur & Darkness sliders, and fixed 2:1 Background Cropper

Developer Mode & Offline Custom Lyrics Editor (v2.0.2): Tap Build number 7 times in Settings > About to unlock Developer mode with Write & TAP Sync editor, .lrc/.txt import/export, and Room offline priority over LRCLIB

Lyrics Animation Picker & 5 Transition Styles (v2.0.1): Settings > Lyrics > Lyrics animation sheet with 5 looping live-preview cards (Slide Up, Blur Fade, Karaoke Fill, Typewriter, Pop Zoom) and Both/App/Widget targeting
